detail.longDescription:
Handle everyday PDF tasks more easily with practical tools with PDF Reader - Edit PDF File app. Enjoy smooth document reading, highlight text or handwritten notes, scan paper files into PDFs, and many other features of PDF tools. Download this app now!

📕 Main Features
➤ Smooth and comfortable document viewing
➤ Add annotations, comments, and handwritten marks
➤ Fast PDF Scanner
➤ Merge multiple PDFs into one
➤ Compress PDF to reduce large files
➤ Connect to the printer to print PDF instantly

♦️ PDF Reader and PDF Viewer
• Open PDF files quickly
• View study materials and work documents smoothly
• Have a comfortable PDF reading experience

♦️ PDF Editor 
• Highlight PDF text
• Add notes, underline useful information
• Draw or add marks
• Review and edit PDF files easily

♦️ Scan PDF Files
• Scan paper documents with your phone camera
• Convert receipts, forms, and notes into PDFs
• Digitize certificates and contracts
• Save scanned documents for later use
• Share PDF scans through supported apps

♦️ Image to PDF
• Convert photos into PDF files
• Select images directly from your gallery
• Combine multiple images into one PDF
• Create PDFs from receipts, notes, and certificates
• Organize images in the correct order

♦️ Merge PDF Files
• Combine multiple PDF files into one document
• Merge reports, assignments, and scanned pages
• Arrange PDF files in your preferred order
• Keep related documents together
• Create one complete PDF for easier sharing

♦️ Compress PDF Files
• Reduce large PDF file sizes
• Save more storage space on your phone
• Prepare PDFs for email and messaging apps
• Make documents faster to upload and share
• Keep PDF files easier to manage

♦️ Bookmark PDF Files
• Save important PDF files to your Favorites
• Access frequently used documents more quickly
• Easy to find your PDFs
• Remove files from Favorites whenever needed

♦️ Print PDF Documents
• Connect to a supported printer
• Print PDF files directly from your phone
• Print reports, forms, and invoices
• Prepare physical copies of contracts and tickets
• Print study materials whenever needed

♦️ Manage PDF Files
• Sort PDFs by date or file size
• Search PDF files by name
• Rename documents easily
• Delete files you no longer need
• Share PDF files through other apps

👉 This app not only provides fast and smooth PDF viewing but also makes everyday document tasks more convenient. Students and office users can read study materials, check work documents, edit PDF files, and scan paper documents directly from their phones.

💌 Thank you for choosing our app. We hope it helps you manage PDF documents more easily and save time throughout your day.
